CreationDesc: The lone White Mage who survived the storm
Lore: Beyond the end, after the Time Loop was over, Navras found himself in an empty world. Neither it was the world of past or the one he lived, or either the promissed world, without ever meeting the fiends. All the world was there, but no life was around. No bird or fish, no human, elf or dwarf. Not even a monster was lurking. Navras was... truly alone. How this was suposed to be his reward? After facing the ordeal of four as only one... surely something accordingly karmic should await him. Without no other choice, Navras choose to meditate, to commune with the spirit, only to find none. Searching deeper and wider in the soul of all things, Navras eventually found an sentience, but somewhere he never expected: in his own inventory. Every enchanted armor and weapon he carried had a spirit embued with magic, and they conferenced with him. In the end, they all concured that they were in still point of time, which meant that even defeating Chaos and breaking the Time Loop, it is impossible to know how many times the loop actually happened - the damage caused in time may be beyond compreension. In order to move through time, Navras and the spirits of the artifacts decided to unite into a magical singularity, all focused on the Ultima blade, the strongest of then; every one of their spirits lost account of how much time passed on that land still, but eventually, a new blade was born, carrying the traits of all artifacts. The Ultima blade, reborn, became two; one from the hilt and one from the heart. The hilt beared a blade that could cut a rift throught time. The heart could carry souls and spirits through those rifts. Time needed healing, and Navras found himself as the only one who could - the White Wizard who survived alone. And so, Navras found out that the karma did not rewarded him with rest or treasure, but with a plea of help. He was the reward, for the world deserved one. Navras smiled, as he sheated the Nessuno Blade and stood atop of the Prima Weapon into the unknow...

CreationDesc: A family of Neopians with draconic ascendance. * Valian Zaxion: A treasure hunter who searched for his brothers from the moment he was born in an empty nest. Valiant and smart, he hoarded a treasure worth of a dragon, founding the Relicarium to maximize profits at first, but became kind of a point for adventurers to gather and organize new adventures; *
Lore: As their floating island lost power and felt from the skies, the Zaxions found themselves slowly falling down in a unknow place. It was no longer in Neopia, but a very different world. Many creatures very similar to wingless faeries passed by the lands around their island, and eventurally they started trading their goods from their hoard, creating a good wealth in the new world. Their island would never float again, but a unique occurence started to happen, and quite frequently: many creature very similar to then would appear. They would come to learn about humans and animals, and that those creatures in particular were a mix of both. Youkais, spirits, mobians, lycans, ponies, furries... As patreons of those gathering souls, as well as the city that now surrounds their former island, they decided to coin a term for those who shared similar physical and even cultural traits. From now on, the citizens of Faunhill would be called as "Fables". The town would grow and choose their own mayor from time to time, but the Zaxions still exert an positive influence over all Fable society, even outside Faunhill, to this very day.

The major one, the XXXXXXX, is so well hidden only Kimerael knows how to get inside; in there, he keeps the knowledge to build any and every piece of tecnology available in the island, as well as specimen of each Pals species... and even humans slaved from all factions. Kimerael is cold and calculating, and prefer to side with the Pal at all times, but does not hesitate to sacrifice anyone to achieve his goals: the greater good he believes he was born - or made - to achieve.

GameDesc: An idle horde-survivor game, where you play as a misterious alchemist in search for his "philosofal stone", shattered and spread across countless dimensions. Now, gathering treasures and allies all over multiverse, this immortal alchemist fights countless enemies until the very end of time.
CreationDesc: Across time and space, the Alchemist changed its shape countless times, and even met himself - from other moments or even alternate realities. Athanor is... different. Once it came in contact with a misterious power called "The Will", Athanor's knowledge over alchemy changed. Athanor became capable of understanding the fabric of infinity, and eventually became able to recollect all the shards.It is a master of disguise; born as an homunculus, the knowledge of alchemy allows Athanor to change any and everything about himself, from the shape, gender and even its scent. It has assumed many personas over the aeons, and nobody was ever capable of figuring that those were, in fact, the same person.
Lore: The Family could not believe it. One of their trusted allies transformed in front of their eyes into a complete stranger. An androginous man of clear skin and a gigant white flowing mane, adorning a impossibly white tuxedo with a waterlily on the lappel. NEVER anyone ever got so close to The Goddess without the concent of The Family since the very foundation of the Ilhaverde. Not only that, the timing was awful: NONE of The Family members were there at that moment. The Hooded Guard wasted not a second and jumped over the stranger, who easily swayed all their effort like a subtle dance. They called for help, and just a few seconds later, The Son was the first to arrive. The stranger immediately felt the danger and shapeshifter into something far more menacing - a man with dragon horns and eyes, a cloak weaved in pure mana, surrounded by an orb of absurd power, and holding a sword in one hand, and a gun in another. The Son was never one to take chances, and conjured a condensed sun in his fist to strike the stranger. The foe, however, did not seemed impressed and kept its battle stance with a calm demeanor. The strike, however, did not land; suddenly The Father appeared by The Son side and held his arm. Ever with a gentle face under his hood, he explained that he knew the stranger, and it was his will that brought it into Entropia. The Father, however, did not know how to identify the stranger due to the nature of its power, but he knew that it would make its move eventually. The stranged did not seemed impressed, until The Father called him by a name: Athanor. The stranger's expression showed a deep concern and surprise for a whole second, and then became serious. The Father's further gently embraced his shoulder, leading to a talking walk around the garden, to the very confused eyes of everyone around. Well, except The Goddess; she mumbled something about The Father being a stubborn man with unnecessary complicated plans...
